correctness.rationale: The graph-neighbourhood sum identity and exact defender trichotomy yield necessary and sufficient admissibility conditions on nine pair types; multinomial counting is bijective. The lower bound separates cases by two-label support and handles n=2,3,4. Constructive labels attain weight six for every n at least three. Minimum counts follow from 3t+2u=n+3 and an exact two-event inclusion-exclusion. Independent exhaustive neighbourhood enumeration equals the multinomial polynomial and closed optimum counts for each n=2,...,7.

value.rationale: The matching-deleted balanced biclique is a natural and highly symmetric perturbation of the complete bipartite graph. The exact signed total Roman minimum jumps from two to six for all n at least four, exposing sensitivity to removing one 1-factor, while the theorem gives the full labelled weight distribution and exact parity-sensitive optimum multiplicities beyond previously known minimum values. This motivated infinite classification has nontrivial inclusion-exclusion obstructions and provides a reusable exact enumeration, not an arbitrary finite slice.
